name: Sulphur
tagline: An essential element. A world of applications.
description: Bene LLC sources sulphur for fertilizer production, mineral processing and industrial chemistry. Discuss granular, lump, prilled or pastilled material matched to your handling and processing requirements.
specs: Granular, lump, prilled or pastilled; subject to availability
Producer certificate of analysis; dry-basis specification agreed per offer
Moisture, ash, acidity and particle size agreed before contracting
Bulk or suitable bags, agreed for the shipment
Independent quantity and quality inspection by agreement
applications: Sulphuric acid and phosphate fertilizer production
enquiry: Required form, purity and impurity limits; quantity in metric tonnes; destination port; packaging; delivery window; preferred trade terms.
note: Availability and final specifications depend on producer, origin and contract. The crystal illustration represents the material, not a shipment sample.
sources: Aditya Birla Global Trading — sulphur forms

name: Urea
description: Nitrogen fertilizer for agricultural supply chains. Bene LLC handles enquiries for granular and prilled urea, with grade, physical characteristics and packing agreed around your market and application.
specs: 46% N is a common fertilizer grade; confirm the offered analysis
Biuret, moisture, particle size and anti-caking treatment per producer specification
Bulk, jumbo bags or smaller bags as agreed
Certificate of analysis and shipment documents by contract
applications: Fertilizer distribution and blending where compatible
Industrial applications only when a suitable technical grade is specified
enquiry: Granular or prilled grade; nitrogen, biuret and moisture limits; quantity in metric tonnes; packaging; destination; delivery window.
note: 46% N is a general product reference, not a guaranteed Bene shipment analysis. Technical and automotive grades require separate qualification.

name: Crude oil
tagline: Energy starts with the right source.
description: Crude oil sourcing aligned with refinery requirements. Bene LLC coordinates enquiries around the nominated grade, origin, crude assay, cargo size and delivery programme.
specs: Crude petroleum; distinct from used or recycled oil
Named and verified for each offer
API gravity and reference temperature per assay
Mass percentage per grade and assay
Water and sediment, salt, viscosity, pour point and distillation profile as required
Loading/discharge terminal, cargo quantity, laycan and trade terms agreed in contract
applications: Refining into transport fuels and other petroleum products
Petrochemical feedstock supply following refining or processing
enquiry: Named crude grade or acceptable assay range; quantity in barrels or metric tonnes; terminal; delivery window; preferred trade terms; buyer requirements.
note: No single crude specification applies to every grade. Cargo availability, origin and quality must be confirmed for each offer.
sources: EIA — crude oil input quality measures

name: LNG
tagline: Natural gas. Connected to new markets.
description: Liquefied natural gas for power and industrial energy supply. Bene LLC develops trading enquiries around cargo requirements, gas quality, delivery timing and receiving-terminal compatibility.
specs: Liquefied natural gas (LNG), distinct from LPG
Primarily methane; composition agreed for the cargo
Liquefied at approximately −162°C at atmospheric pressure
Heating value, Wobbe index, nitrogen, heavier hydrocarbons and contaminants per agreed specification
Cargo volume or energy basis, stated with measurement conditions
Vessel, receiving terminal, unloading window and gas quality confirmed before contracting
enquiry: Receiving terminal; cargo or energy quantity; gas-quality limits; vessel compatibility; delivery window; spot or term requirement; trade terms.
note: Temperature is a general physical reference. Cargo quality, pressure and handling conditions depend on the agreed technical specification.
